transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because I can’t seem to stay focused anymore. At work I’ll be doing inventory and keep reading the same line, or I’ll go to the supply closet and forget what I went in there for. I’ve been trying to study for the supervisor certification too, but it’s hard to keep my mind on it.
About how long have you been experiencing these difficulties with your focus and memory?
About three years now, I think. It started after the contractor moved us onto rotating evening and overnight shifts at the bigger properties.
How has your sleep been since you started working those rotating shifts?

It’s been pretty messed up. After an overnight shift, I’ll be exhausted but still lie there unable to settle down. And even if I sleep what seems like enough hours, I wake up feeling like I hardly rested at all.
Does your sleep improve when you have several days off in a row or take time away from work?
Not really. Even with a few days off, I can still be lying there exhausted but unable to settle down. And when I do get a decent amount of sleep, I wake up feeling like it barely did anything.
Do you struggle with excessive sleepiness or fighting off sleep while you are on shift at work?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed myself actually fighting to stay awake on shift.
Are you currently still working these rotating evening and overnight shifts?
Yeah, I’m still on them. It’s been about three years now, since the contractor switched us to rotating evening and overnight shifts at the bigger properties.
Have you had an extended period off, such as a vacation lasting a week or more, and if so, did your sleep return to normal during that time?

I haven’t had a week or more off recently. But even when I get a few days away from work, my sleep doesn’t really straighten out. After overnights I’m still tired but wired, and if I do sleep enough hours, I wake up like I barely rested.
